definitions.explanation: The shrine complex in Ise, Mie Prefecture, dedicated to the sun goddess Amaterasu, ancestral deity of the imperial family, and regarded as the most sacred place in Shinto. It consists of the Inner and Outer Shrines and many smaller ones.

examples.japanese: {伊勢神宮|いせじんぐう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦お{参|まい}り→お参り：16837_omairi⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。

examples.english: Ise Shrine is in Mie Prefecture.

notes:
Officially just ⟦{神宮|じんぐう}→神宮：17736_jinguu⟧; people often call it お⟦{伊勢|いせ}→伊勢：30733_ise⟧さん or お⟦{伊勢|いせ}→伊勢：30733_ise⟧さま.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- お{伊勢参|いせまい}り: a pilgrimage to Ise, hugely popular in the Edo period
- {内宮|ないくう} / {外宮|げくう}: the Inner and Outer Shrines
- {式年遷宮|しきねんせんぐう}: the rebuilding of the shrines every twenty years

CULTURAL NOTE:
The Inner Shrine enshrines {天照大神|あまてらすおおみかみ}, the sun goddess from whom the imperial line claims descent. In the Edo period millions of commoners made the journey to Ise, at times in sudden mass pilgrimages called おかげ{参|まい}り.
